dishes.make_ahead: Make the aioli up to 1 day ahead and keep the prawns cold

steps.text: Beat the mayonnaise with the garlic, lemon zest and juice.
Butter the bread and cut into triangles.
Pile the prawns on a platter with the lemon wedges and serve with the aioli.

veg.n: Asparagus with lemon aioli and buttered bread (vegetarian)

steps.text: Beat the mayonnaise with the garlic, lemon zest and juice.
Blanch the asparagus for 3 minutes in boiling salted water, then cool in iced water.
Butter the bread and cut into triangles.
Pile the asparagus on a platter with lemon wedges and serve with the aioli.

veg.make_ahead: Make the aioli up to 1 day ahead and keep the asparagus chilled

steps.text: Score the squid and cut into pieces.
Toss with the oil, garlic, chilli and salt.
Grill on a very hot barbecue for a minute a side.
Finish with lime juice and coriander.
Slice the mushrooms thickly lengthways and score in a criss-cross.
Toss with the oil, garlic, chilli and salt.
Grill on a very hot barbecue for 2 minutes a side.
Finish with lime juice and coriander.

dishes.n: Dampier sausages, steak and potato salad
dishes.make_ahead: Potato salad up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, cool and dress with mayonnaise and chives.
Grill the sausages and steaks over hot coals.
Fry the onions on the hotplate until golden.
Serve with a stack of white bread and the potato salad.

veg.n: Dampier sausages, mushroom steaks and potato salad (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Potato salad up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, cool and dress with mayonnaise and chives.
Brush the sausages and mushrooms with oil and grill over medium coals, turning, until browned.
Fry the onions on the hotplate until golden.
Serve with a stack of white bread and the potato salad.

dishes.n: Mine canteen jam roly-poly and custard
dishes.make_ahead: Roll and wrap up to 4 hours ahead; bake just before dinner

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour and sugar and mix in enough milk for a soft dough.
Roll out, spread with the jam, roll up and wrap in baking paper and foil.
Bake at 180C.
Heat the milk, custard powder and sugar, whisking until thick.
Slice the roll and pour custard over.

dishes.make_ahead: Grapefruit soda up to 1 day, chilled

steps.text: Juice the grapefruit and stir with the sugar until dissolved.
Mix with the soda water and chill well.
Half fill 4 tall glasses with lager.
Top with the grapefruit soda and add a wedge. Serve the soda on its own for the drivers.

af.make_ahead: Grapefruit soda up to 1 day, chilled

steps.text: Juice the grapefruit and stir with the sugar until dissolved.
Mix with the soda water and chill well.
Half fill 4 tall glasses with the alcohol-free lager.
Top with the grapefruit soda and add a wedge.
